name: hvac-prospect-crm
description: Lightweight self-hostable B2B CRM for HVAC contractor prospecting

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.ci:install: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.audit: npm --prefix server audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --audit-level=high
scripts.test:local: npm run test:local:api && npm run test:local:browser && npm run test:local:workflow
